data.name: ConversationLabel
data.comment: Label of the conversation list; the underscore marks the access key.

data.name: ConversationListName
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the conversation list.

data.name: NewConversationTitle
data.comment: Title of a conversation before its first message.

data.name: NewConversationButton
data.comment: Button that starts a new conversation.

data.name: NewConversationName
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the New button.

data.name: NewConversationToolTip
data.value: Start a new conversation; this one stays in the list until Visual Studio closes
data.comment: Tooltip of the New button.

data.name: RenameConversationButton
data.comment: Button that renames the conversation.

data.name: RenameConversationName
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the Rename button.

data.name: RenameConversationToolTip
data.comment: Tooltip of the Rename button.

data.name: RenameBoxName
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the box that edits the conversation name.

data.name: RenameBoxHelp
data.value: Type a name. Enter saves it; Esc cancels.
data.comment: Help text of the rename box.

data.name: DeleteConversationButton
data.comment: Button that deletes the conversation.

data.name: DeleteConversationName
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the Delete button.

data.name: DeleteConversationToolTip
data.comment: Tooltip of the Delete button.

data.name: DeleteConversationConfirmFormat
data.value: Delete the conversation "{0}"? It cannot be restored.
data.comment: Delete confirmation. {0} is the conversation title.

data.name: ConversationItemNameFormat
data.comment: Screen-reader name of a conversation in the list. {0} is its title, {1} the number of messages.

data.name: PlainTextLanguage
data.comment: Language name of a code block without a known language.

data.name: CodeBlockNameFormat
data.comment: Tooltip and screen-reader name of a code block. {0} is the language, for example C#.

data.name: CopyCodeButton
data.comment: Button that copies a code block.

data.name: CopyCodeNameFormat
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the Copy button. {0} is the language.

data.name: CopyCodeToolTip
data.value: Copy the code to the clipboard
data.comment: Tooltip of the Copy button.

data.name: CodeCopied
data.comment: Note shown after the code was copied.

data.name: CopyFailed
data.value: The clipboard is busy; try again.
data.comment: Note shown when the clipboard could not be written.

data.name: InsertCodeButton
data.comment: Button that inserts a code block into the active document.

data.name: InsertCodeNameFormat
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the Insert at cursor button. {0} is the language.

data.name: InsertCodeToolTip
data.value: Insert the code into the active document at the caret, replacing any selection (one undo step)
data.comment: Tooltip of the Insert at cursor button.

data.name: CodeInsertedFormat
data.comment: Note shown after inserting. {0} is the document file name.

data.name: ActiveDocumentName
data.comment: Used in "Inserted into {0}." when the document has no file name.

data.name: InsertNoDocument
data.value: Open a document and place the caret where the code should go.
data.comment: Note shown when there is no document to insert into.

data.name: InsertReadOnly
data.comment: Note shown when the active document cannot be edited.

data.name: OpenLinkTitle
data.comment: Title of the open-link confirmation.

data.name: OpenLinkConfirmFormat
data.value:
Open this link in your browser?
{0}
data.comment: Open-link confirmation. {0} is the full address.

data.name: LinkAsciiHostFormat
data.comment: Added to the open-link confirmation when the host name is internationalised. {0} is its ASCII (punycode) form.

data.name: LinkToolTipFormat
data.comment: Tooltip of a link. {0} is the address.

data.name: UnsafeLinkToolTipFormat
data.value: Not opened: only http, https and mailto links can be opened ({0})
data.comment: Tooltip of a link that is never opened. {0} is the address as written.

data.name: ImageAltFormat
data.comment: Text shown in place of an image, which is never downloaded. {0} is the alt text.

data.name: ImageWithoutAlt
data.comment: Text shown in place of an image without alt text.

data.name: ImageToolTipFormat
data.comment: Tooltip of an image placeholder. {0} is the image address.

data.name: HeadingNameFormat
data.comment: Screen-reader name of a heading. {0} is the level, {1} the text.

data.name: ListNameFormat
data.comment: Screen-reader name of a list. {0} is the number of items.

data.name: TableNameFormat
data.comment: Screen-reader name of a table. {0} is the number of rows, {1} of columns.

data.name: QuoteName
data.comment: Screen-reader name of a block quote.

data.name: RuleName
data.comment: Screen-reader name of a horizontal rule.

data.name: ReplyContentName
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the rendered content of a reply.
